boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain SUNY Oneonta
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with currently published evening or overnight availability in Oneonta.

cards.title: Mills Marketplace
cards.subtitle: SUNY Oneonta campus
cards.notes: Use the campus marketplace when you need an on-campus option after other dining locations have closed; verify the daily schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Campus retail food option with the latest published on-campus hours.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta lists Marketplace hours as 11:00 AM–1:00 AM daily for the Fall 2026–Spring 2027 operating schedule.
cards.access_notes: Published schedule lists 11:00 AM–1:00 AM Sunday through Saturday; operating schedules can change during breaks.

cards.title: Late Night at Mills Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: 28 Service Drive, SUNY Oneonta
cards.notes: On Monday through Thursday, plan for the dedicated late-night service at Mills; check the dining schedule first because the service is not offered every day.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining hall with separately scheduled late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Oneonta’s dining schedule lists Late Night at Mills from 8:00 PM–10:00 PM Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Published late-night service is 8:00–10:00 PM Monday–Thursday; closed Friday through Sunday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on State Highway 28
cards.subtitle: 732 State Highway 28, Oneonta
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest listed availability; the restaurant dining room has earlier published closing times than the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A Oneonta drive-thru with hours extending into early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this Oneonta location’s drive-thru until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday; published dine-in hours end at 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Subway at Mirabito C-Store SouthSide
cards.subtitle: 4968 NY 23, Oneonta
cards.notes: Choose this sandwich counter when an overnight option matters; confirm in-store service availability when you arrive at the convenience-store location.
cards.short_summary: A Subway location whose official listing publishes 24-hour store hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway lists its Mirabito C-Store SouthSide location at 4968 NY 23 as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists store hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on State Highway 23
cards.subtitle: 6281 State Highway 23, Oneonta
cards.notes: This is a midnight option with both restaurant and drive-thru hours published; check holiday notices before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A Oneonta fast-food location open until midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 AM–12:00 AM daily at 6281 State Highway 23.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru open until 12:00 AM daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Applebee’s on State Highway 23
cards.subtitle: 5006 State Highway 23, Oneonta
cards.notes: For a seated meal or pickup, use the published restaurant schedule and confirm any holiday exceptions directly with the location.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant with midnight hours on most nights and family-oriented dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee’s lists this Oneonta restaurant open until 12:00 AM Monday–Saturday and 10:00 PM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published restaurant hours are until 12:00 AM Monday–Saturday and 10:00 PM Sunday.

cards.title: Asian Cuisine on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 148 Main Street / 16 Water Street, Oneonta
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner stop for the latest listed hours; use the restaurant’s own location page to reconfirm before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Asian restaurant listed open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Asian Cuisine lists Friday and Saturday operating hours of 11:00 AM–11:00 PM at its Oneonta location.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11:00 AM–11:00 PM Friday–Saturday; 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Monday–Thursday; Sunday until 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Oneonta Indian Grill
cards.subtitle: 214 Main Street, Oneonta
cards.notes: Set this downtown restaurant aside for a later dinner earlier in the week; it lists a consistent 10 PM close Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant with dinner service listed through 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Oneonta Indian Grill lists operating hours of 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday.

cards.title: Number One Chinese Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 511 Main Street, Oneonta
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s pickup or delivery ordering page to time a Friday or Saturday order before its latest listed 10 PM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street Chinese restaurant with late-week service through 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Number One Chinese Restaurant lists Friday–Saturday takeout hours from 11:00 AM–10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Number One Chinese Restaurant — Online Ordering
cards.access_notes: Published takeout hours run until 10:00 PM Friday–Saturday; earlier closing times apply other open days.

cards.title: Denny’s on State Highway 23
cards.subtitle: 4979 State Highway 23, Oneonta
cards.notes: Use the official location schedule to plan a Friday or Saturday visit; the page publishes later weekend closing than its weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A diner with the latest listed dining-room hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its Oneonta restaurant open until 9:30 PM Friday and Saturday, with earlier closing times on other days.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 9:30 PM Friday–Saturday; 8:30 PM Monday–Thursday and Sunday. Check holiday hours directly.
